annotation.title_clean: 无锡市车联网发展促进条例
annotation.title_en: Wuxi Municipal Regulations on Promoting the Development of the Internet of Vehicles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 无锡市人民代表大会常务委员会 (Wuxi Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee); approved by Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee
annotation.summary_en: Local regulation of Wuxi city promoting the Internet of Vehicles and intelligent connected (autonomous) vehicles, covering infrastructure, road testing and commercial deployment, industry innovation, and security. Effective 1 March 2023, it takes an inclusive, prudent regulatory approach and promotes the national IoV pilot zone.
key_provisions_or_claims: Governments must plan and build IoV infrastructure and a unified data management platform.
Road tests and demonstrations are managed in tiers by risk, with vehicles required to record data, be monitored online and carry emergency devices.
Personal information and important data must be stored domestically, with a security assessment before any export.
Traffic violations and accidents involving intelligent connected vehicles are handled under road traffic safety law; insurance must meet national rules.
Encourages a social risk fund for victims and adopts tolerance-of-error, inclusive and prudent supervision.
